```sql
WITH combined_attendance AS (
    -- 2023 data
    SELECT
        "Centre" AS "Centre Name",
        "Month",
        NULLIF("Enrolled Kids", 0) AS "Enrolled Kids",
        NULLIF("Avg Daily Present", 0) AS "Avg Daily Present",
        1 AS "Year"
    FROM "attendance_2023"
    WHERE "Centre" IN ('Chembur Balwadi', 'Dharavi Balwadi', 'Govandi Balwadi', 'Kurla Balwadi', 'Mankhurd Balwadi', 'Sion Balwadi', 'Wadala Balwadi', 'Worli Balwadi')
    AND "Month" IN ('January', 'February', 'March', 'April', 'May', 'June', 'July', 'August', 'September', 'October', 'November', 'December')

    UNION ALL

    -- 2024 data with name matching
    SELECT
        "centre_name" AS "Centre Name",
        "month",
        NULLIF("enrolment", 0) AS "Enrolled Kids",
        NULLIF("average_attendance", 0) AS "Avg Daily Present",
        2 AS "Year"
    FROM "attendance_2024"
    WHERE jaro_winkler_similarity(lower(trim("centre_name")), lower(trim("Centre"))) >= 0.9
    AND "month" IN ('January', 'February', 'March', 'April', 'May', 'June', 'July', 'August', 'September', 'October', 'November', 'December')
),

yearly_turnout AS (
    SELECT
        "Centre Name",
        "Year",
        AVG(("Avg Daily Present"::FLOAT / NULLIF("Enrolled Kids", 0)) * 100) AS "Average Turnout Rate (%)"
    FROM combined_attendance
    GROUP BY "Centre Name", "Year"
)

SELECT
    "Centre Name",
    MAX(CASE WHEN "Year" = 1 THEN "Average Turnout Rate (%)" END) AS "2023 Average Turnout Rate (%)",
    MAX(CASE WHEN "Year" = 2 THEN "Average Turnout Rate (%)" END) AS "2024 Average Turnout Rate (%)"
FROM yearly_turnout
GROUP BY "Centre Name"
ORDER BY "Centre Name";
```
